paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to request further information about a flexible working discussion. I am interested in flexible working hours and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích mình cần thông tin gì.

parts.text: and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to request further information about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am interested in [chủ đề] and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.text: My main concern is that I have limited experience and would prefer a practical introduction. I understand that participants will compare working schedules and plan shared team hours.
